notes: F9_1_main (F9_1.lean, core): 9 points a + b*rho (a, b in Z[omega], rho = 5/6 + i sqrt11/6) with 19 distinct unit circles through >= 3 of them, so 19 <= f(9) <= 24. Outside Lean: the 4-tuple model of Q(sqrt3, sqrt11) embeds in R (linear independence of 1, sqrt3, sqrt11, sqrt33); the upper bound 24 (Harborth-Mengersen) is cited.

sources.cite: H. Harborth, I. Mengersen, Point sets with many unit circles, Discrete Math. 60 (1986) 193-197

prior_art.note: Lower bound 16 previously (trivial from f(8)); 19 not found stated.
